summary: Pluri Inc. (Israel-based) filed an 8-K regarding ongoing negotiations with the European Investment Bank (EIB) over a €50 million finance agreement, of which €20 million was drawn in June 2021 at 4% interest, maturing June 1, 2026. The EIB has confirmed constructive discussions through July 3, 2026, with no enforcement action currently contemplated. However, no resolution is assured. This filing is a non-routine disclosure of a potential debt restructuring or forbearance scenario, not a standard current report. Watch for extension terms or restructuring of the EIB loan; risk includes potential default or forced repayment.
